body: DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system
plain_description: **Run fast analytics directly inside your application, without managing a separate database server.** Read local or remote files and query data across connected databases. Use SQL through a standalone command line tool or language clients.
technical_description: DuckDB is an in-process analytical database designed to be fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use. It supports a rich SQL dialect, reads and writes formats including CSV, Parquet, JSON, and Excel from local or remote sources, and can query connected PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and DuckDB databases. It is available as a standalone CLI and through multiple language clients, with a runtime extension mechanism.
title: DuckDB
